template_data.headline_html: Five questions I answer on every first call.

items.title: Do we qualify?
items.sub: Two years in business, commercial revenue, clean SAM.gov registration — that's the short version.

items.title: How long will it take?
items.sub: 6–12 months is typical. Organized financials and past performance docs cut the timeline.

items.title: Will we get contracts?
items.sub: The Schedule is market access, not a guarantee. You still have to sell.

items.title: Can we do it ourselves?
items.sub: Yes. Most who try come back for help around page 40 of the solicitation.

items.title: What if we get rejected?
items.sub: Our team holds a 98% approval rate and offers a money-back guarantee.
